Part massage clinic, part massage therapy school, Ke Kino is here to restore your health. Not simply a place, but a way of life. We treat, heal, and nurture all those who walk through our doors. Our goal is to improve the physical state while also positively affecting the emotional state.

Whether interested in bodywork from our team of advanced therapists or here for an education, we are happy to answer questions. 
https://kekino.com/
